recycled_content.source_quote: Fiberon™ PETG-rCF08 is a high-quality 3D printing filament made from PETG (polyethylene terephthalate glycol) reinforced with 8% recycled carbon fiber.
recycled_content.notes: Only the carbon fibre reinforcement is stated as recycled; the PETG matrix is not. Post-industrial vs post-consumer origin not stated.
